# M9OMS MyTiMic

> A compact push-to-talk electret microphone for portable SSB operating with
> the QRP Labs QMX / QMX+. Adds a PTT filter and a C0G capacitor on the ring
> at the jack, to suppress switching transients that may cause a false "G"
> (GPS protection) indication. Sold at https://m9oms.com

Oscilloscope tests (November 2026) show the filter reduced coupled spikes on
the ring below the -24 mV trigger threshold, a reduction of at least 20x
(26 dB). Values were chosen using the published QMX schematic; results should
not be assumed to apply to other radios that use the same TRS pinout.

## Documentation

- [Overview and measurement summary](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-mytimic-mini-mic/): PCB features, why the PTT filter, results table, compatibility
- [Investigating PTT transients - Part 1](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-mytimic-mini-mic/2026-11-ptt-transient.html): oscilloscope measurements, setup and captures, November 2026
- [Investigating PTT transients - Part 2](https://radio-uncensored.github.io/qrp-mytimic-mini-mic/2026-11-ptt-transient2.html): effect of the TRS cable on the PTT transient, November 2026
